summary: First-finish smoke pass on Ultra Studio Character DNA Builder v2. Verified backend health/settings/CRUD/filters and full frontend flow (Library empty state, Builder save flow, Settings save with toast, Gallery). One HIGH backend bug: /api/renders/dispatch returns HTTP 500 (ObjectId serialization) when ComfyUI is offline instead of the expected render doc with status='offline'. Render doc is actually persisted (visible in Gallery), but the JSON response fails to serialize.
passed: GET /api/settings returns singleton with correct defaults (comfyui_url=http://localhost:8188, model=cognitivecomputations/dolphin-mixtral-8x7b, empty key)
POST /api/characters, GET /api/characters, GET /api/characters/{id}, PATCH /api/characters/{id}, POST /api/characters/{id}/duplicate, DELETE /api/characters/{id} all work
POST /api/renders/dispatch with workflow_type=image and no image_workflow_json returns HTTP 400 with 'No image workflow template set in Settings.'
POST /api/ai/freeform with no OpenRouter key returns HTTP 400 with 'OpenRouter API key not set in Settings' (note: request body field is 'text', not 'prompt')
Frontend Library / shows 'No characters yet' empty state and New Character button

Frontend Builder /character/new: input-character-name accepts input; chip-identity-gender-female clickable; prompt-string-preview updates ('44 year old, female, hair'); btn-randomize-all works; btn-save-character saves and navigates to /character/{id}; new character visible in Library
Frontend /settings loads defaults; btn-save-settings triggers 'Saved' toast
Frontend /gallery renders (shows previously-dispatched render tiles with status 'offline'/'failed' correctly)

failed.issue: Returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' instead of a render doc with status='offline'. Root cause per backend traceback: FastAPI response serialization fails with ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]. The Mongo document (including _id ObjectId) is being returned directly without being converted to the Pydantic Render model / without stripping _id.
failed.evidence: curl -X POST /api/renders/dispatch {workflow_type:'image', positive_prompt:'a woman', negative_prompt:'blurry'} with a valid image_workflow_json in Settings -> HTTP 500. Backend log: /root/.venv/.../fastapi/encoders.py line 327 vars(obj); ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]. Gallery UI shows the persisted 'offline' render tile, confirming the doc is saved but response serialization fails.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py, in the renders/dispatch handler, return a serializable object: either construct/return a Render Pydantic model (excluding _id) or run the Mongo doc through a helper that drops '_id' and casts ObjectIds. Currently the raw Mongo insert result / find_one() dict with ObjectId _id is being returned, which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize.
Verify the same fix also applies to any other endpoint that returns Mongo docs directly (spot-check /api/renders list, etc.).

Optional (not blocking): also expose data-testid=btn-new-character on the mobile visible 'Create your first' / bottom-nav 'New' buttons so tests don't need to target the hidden sm-only desktop button on small viewports.
